stage1.impression: The idea of a spectrum of glowing cabinets marching down a wet quay against a monumental wall is strong, and the near red and orange pieces look rich and believable, with good puddle reflections. Past the yellow, though, the line shrinks and dissolves into a murky, blotchy blue haze. The wall above the speakers is a flat dark plane rather than tall coloured washes. The bottom-right ground is crushed black, and the right edge (wall end, sky sliver, stair-stepped water) reads as CG.

blocking_9: The eight washes rise visibly at least two speaker heights up the wall as distinct coloured columns that blend where they overlap, not a uniform warm veil
All eight speakers read at a glance: the farthest one is at least 80 px wide and separated tonally from the haze behind it
No denoiser blotching or volume noise on the dark wall and haze (right third of the frame)
The wet quay reads as surface everywhere: no crushed black in the bottom-right quadrant, with the moon giving a faint raking sheen
The right edge (river, far bank, sky) reads as a real, calm river at night with distant lights, not stair-stepped stripes

defects.what: Upper wall is a flat dark plane (lum median 32, range 18) with an even red cast. The washes do not climb.
The washes are a low, blended glow (lum range 23) rather than distinct tall columns per speaker
Mottled denoiser/volume blotching on the dark wall and haze, plus speckle
Ground crushed (lum median 8.7, crush 8.6%), dead area with no surface read
The far three speakers are under 50 px wide and melt into the haze. Smoke is barely distinguishable from Fog.
River at the right edge shows regular stair-step ripple stripes that look like tiling
Empty grey sky sliver with the wall's end cut against it, with no far bank or city lights. It reads as a set edge.
Red speaker's interior near clipping (p95 194, clip 0.37%). It is flat pink-white where the batts face the camera.

changes.problem: The coloured washes stop low and blur into a general warm veil, so the frame's main idea (tall washes rising up a monumental wall) does not read.

evidence.measured: Wall 0-400 lum median 32 vs 450-700 lum median 45. The y-profile at x 250-300 rises only from 25 to 56, and the x lum range at the wash height is 23.

change.to: 550 W, spread 60 (cone and power only; place unchanged), with render exposure 1.0 -> 0.85 to hold the cabinets

changes.expected: More light leaves the top and back of each cabinet, and each colour throws a distinct column at least 2.5 m up the wall. The wall at y 300-600 brightens to a median of about 55, with visible separation between columns.

changes.problem: The haze is thick enough to veil the wall and wash out the columns, and it is the source of the blotchy noise on the right.

evidence.measured: Lum median 48 on a wall that should be dark, blue-grey veil (b 61 vs r 40), with visible mottling at 2x

changes.expected: The board-formed texture and the coloured columns gain contrast. The far wall goes darker and cleaner, and light still glows softly around each cabinet.

changes.problem: The 24 mm lens at 0.8 m forces the line into steep perspective: the near red speaker dominates, and the far four are under 50 px and lost.

evidence.measured: Far three speakers about 40-50 px wide vs the red one at 245 px. Smoke's lum median of 66 is indistinguishable from the haze.

changes.expected: The row reads as a gentle diagonal, with the farthest speaker at least 80 px wide, more of the wall visible above for the washes, and less dead ground in the foreground.

changes.problem: The bottom-right paving is crushed black, so the wet quay stops reading as a surface outside the puddle reflections.

change.to: irradiance 0.6, position [12.0, -14.0, 4.0] (lower, raking from the river side so its specular sheen falls on the wet granite)

changes.expected: A faint cool sheen across the wet granite and visible tile joints in the foreground, while still clearly night

changes.problem: Volume and denoiser blotching on the dark right third says "render".

evidence.measured: Visible mottled low-frequency patches at 2x crop, lum p5-p95 of 44-73 on a flat wall

change.to: samples 512 or more with volume step rate 0.5 and the denoiser on albedo+normal passes, then a 1-1.5% fine film grain in post

changes.expected: Smooth dark tones with fine, even grain and no low-frequency blotches

changes.problem: The river at the right edge shows regular stair-step stripes, and the opposite bank is empty, so the edge of the world shows.

evidence.measured: Regular horizontal banding (lum range 38 in narrow repeating stripes). Props 5 and 6 (far-bank glows) are not visible.

change.to: ripple 0.02, ripple_m 1.5; emit 12 / 6, broken into several shorter boxes of varied length to read as distant windows and streetlights

changes.expected: Calm black water with long, broken warm reflections of a far bank, giving depth at the right edge

changes.problem: The nearest (red) cabinet's interior is near clipping and flattens to pink-white, losing the tinted-acrylic depth.

change.to: about 0.75x of the c1 value for up0 only, to balance near/far

changes.expected: Red interior holds saturated red with no clipping, with the batt texture visible

changes.problem: The wall's upper half is an even dark red-brown with no board-form relief, so it does not feel monumental.

evidence.measured: Lum range 18.5, r 43 / g 28 / b 28: a uniform warm cast

changes.expected: The board seams and tie holes read in the grazing upward light, and the wall gains scale

out_of_scope.request: Make the Smoke speaker more distinguishable (it is near-invisible against the haze)
out_of_scope.why: Its colour and material are fixed. Only framing, haze and light (c2, c3) may help.

out_of_scope.request: Make the horn's internal throat less of a dark blob through the tinted top
out_of_scope.why: The horn's shape is set by acoustic simulation
